swap_run.use: per-decision swap distances (TV, top-1 agreement) of the same 40,702 decisions, in the same order

sealed_g0_run.use: the G0 side of the comparison: recorded planning Q, mask and reference law of every evaluated decision (June 2025, 150 games)

reading_fixed_before_results.PREDICTOR_EFFECT_BEYOND_NOISE: mean excess TV >= 0.01 and its 95% whole-game bootstrap lower bound > 0: the predictor swap moves the recommendations by more than a seed change does; report to the user, who decides on stage C and the review gates; nothing runs automatically
reading_fixed_before_results.WITHIN_SEARCH_NOISE: otherwise: the EXP-P17-001 distance is not distinguishable from search noise at the registered margin; stage C is not run and the policy re-validation line is closed until new inputs arrive (CV intent data / ARM-A)

verdict.threshold_basis: the 0.01 TV judgement value registered in EXP-P17-001, applied to the excess over the seed distance; no measured basis
verdict.conservative_direction: An independent-seed distance is at least as large as the noise inside the common-random-number swap comparison, so BEYOND is hard to reach and WITHIN does not prove a zero predictor effect.

limits: Registered after the EXP-P17-001 result was read (post-hoc analysis)
An independent-seed distance overstates the noise inside the common-random-number swap comparison: BEYOND is conservative, WITHIN does not prove a zero predictor effect
One alternative seed; model-internal diagnostic, not a policy value estimate
Same-model review only; the independent review gate is not passed
